newsitem.title: GERMANY: Brau & Brunnen slashes H1 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Brau & Brunnen slashes H1 oper loss.

text.p: German beverage group Brau & Brunnen AG reduced its operating loss in the first half of 1997 to less than 20 million marks, a company spokesman said on Thursday at its annual shareholder meeting.
The company, which reported an operating loss of 54.6 million marks in the first half of 1996, said earlier in the year it was striving to break even by 1998.
Brau & Brunnen's new chairman Rainer Verstynen repeated that the company wanted to reduce the number of beer brands that it offers, but it did not plan to drop any of its brands in the near term.
